issues.on_page: Budget-to-actual schedule p7: Sales taxes 231,785 (statement Sales and other taxes 231,786)
issues.issue: The remainder 124,810 of 'Sales and other taxes' stays unlabeled. The p7 schedule prints Sales taxes 231,785, which is 1 less than the whole line, so the line looks like all sales tax. The extractor rejected that breakdown as budget basis and 1 off. This is a judgment call; the same applies to detail[4], [7], [11], [33] and [55] (Park, Community Senior Center, Library, Street and Pool 'Sales and other taxes').

The p7 schedule prints a breakdown that adds up exactly and shows 22,118 of the 'Property taxes' line is motor vehicle tax. The line was kept whole as property tax because the printed label says property taxes. That is defensible, but the user may want the split.
